body.objective: Complete the exceptional and global counterflow Berger blocks by exporting the rowwise SU(2)_L x U(1)_R spatial actions, moment maps and their interaction with charged D, R_rel and K.
body.stop_condition: Import the vector/tensor export and TWO_PHASE_COUNTERFLOW_RESIDUAL_BFV_RECEIVER_OBSTRUCTION_V1. Derive exact 70-row Lie derivatives and cotangent lifts for L1,L2,L3,R3 and the helical K, with the diagonal-U1 action, D and R_rel separately typed. Prove the su(2)+u(1)+R_K commutators on every field, ghost and antifield row, q70 equivariance, cyclicity and moment-map identities. Match the exceptional scalar/vector/tensor zero modes to these actions, classify each as local gauge, global charged, background stabilizer, radical or physical cohomology on both unrestricted and fixed-charge carriers, and export exact exceptional iota/pi maps, descended pairings and characteristic/Jordan blocks. Construct the charge-typed residual BFV receiver only if all required actions exist; otherwise land the first exact row obstruction. Include independent bracket/moment-map verifiers, sign and generator-identification mutations, schema, receipt, report and atlas fragment.
body.current_gate: exceptional/global completion and rowwise spatial stabilizer receiver
body.forbid: no abstract stabilizer algebra substituted for rowwise actions; no K called raw D; no D or R_rel deleted as gauge on the unrestricted carrier; no fixed/unrestricted receiver conflation; no generic harmonic formula used for exceptional modes; no particle or unitarity promotion
body.resource_hint: EXCEPTIONAL/GLOBAL SPLIT. This closes the exact carrier gap shared by the all-Hodge health and residual-BFV tasks. Preserve fixed-charge and unrestricted receivers as distinct objects.
